sentences.content: When interviewed, the scientist stared at the decorations on the ceiling, thinking for a while, and then said, “I’m not in favour of any arbitrary assumption, but undertaking cloning does differ from the straightforward procedure of making loafs out of flour. Until we accumulate enough exact knowledge, any practice is in vain and is bound to fail. Altogether, being more careful is reasonable or we may walk into a side road.”
sentences.english: When interviewed , the scientist stared at the decorations on the ceiling , thinking for a while , and then said ," I'm not in favour of any arbitrary assumption , but undertaking cloning does differ from the straightforward procedure of making loafs out of flour . Until we accumulate enough exact knowledge , any practice is in vain and is bound to fail . Altogether , being more careful is reasonable or we may walk into a side road ."
sentences.chinese: 接受采访时，这位科学家凝视着天花板上的装饰，沉思片刻后说道：“我不赞成任何武断的假设，但进行克隆确实与用面粉制作面包这样简单的过程不同。在我们积累足够精确的知识之前，任何实践都是徒劳的，注定会失败。总之，更加谨慎是合理的，否则我们可能会误入歧途。”

statements.english: When interviewed , the scientist stared at the decorations on the ceiling , thinking for a while , and then said ," I'm not in favour of any arbitrary assumption , but undertaking cloning does differ from the straightforward procedure of making loafs out of flour . Until we accumulate enough exact knowledge , any practice is in vain and is bound to fail . Altogether , being more careful is reasonable or we may walk into a side road ."
